recommendation: Keep the empty no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-33255 unless Patient Care reopens the broader AllergyIntolerance.type semantics in a future issue.
issue_request: FHIR-33255 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution asking Patient Care to clarify the AllergyIntoleranceType CodeSystem definition of intolerance to say the substance is judged to be not allergic or allergy-like, while retaining the non-immune, idiosyncratic, and patient-specific explanatory text.
initial_application: Commit 9640a8b81743c06345b4dcdf7f5e72d89e23c444 applied the Jira-requested wording change in source/allergyintolerance/codesystem-allergy-intolerance-type.xml. Later commit ab195a73a8e6090dbd0620b88025adfc5fbbd3c4 reformatted/updated identifiers and preserved the same clarified definition.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists allergyintolerance=AllergyIntolerance, so the inspected CodeSystem is in current build scope. Patient Care Zulip and Confluence evidence supports the intended distinction: intolerance is non-allergy intolerance, and AllergyIntolerance.type should be omitted when the distinction is unknown. Later same-artifact decisions did not supersede the wording: FHIR-35879 changed AllergyIntolerance.type to CodeableConcept with preferred binding, FHIR-38695 was a duplicate of that change, FHIR-35890 was resolved no-change because existing comments already covered uncertainty, and FHIR-55316 confirmed the value set remains intentionally narrow.
reconciliation: No source file was changed. The current CodeSystem intolerance concept at source/allergyintolerance/codesystem-allergy-intolerance-type.xml:56-58 already matches the FHIR-33255 resolution, and active-source searches found no remaining old 'not judged to be allergic' wording.
